evidence.quote: Located in Bled, just 1 km from the Lake and 1.5 km from the Castle, Apartments Rose in winter offers self-catering accommodation set in a garden with a stream.
Za potokom 1, 4260 Bled, Slovenia
There is a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and an oven.
Free private parking is possible on site (reservation is not needed).
WiFi is available in all areas and is free of charge.
Managed by Barbara
I am grateful for such a wonderful part of our planet to be my home! Welcome to be a part of it at least for your vacation :-) (host profile; lightly edited for the site)
We live in the same house and we are here for you at any moment you need us. + Staff 9.9

I like to swim in our lake Bled, walk around the lake and forests behind our house, sometimes I go to the beautiful Pokljuka just 15 min away with the car, to Bohinj lake and Vogel mountain to ski in the winter
You'll need to let the property know in advance what time you'll arrive.
Children older than 12 years are welcome.
Cots and extra beds are not available at this property.
Smoking is not allowed.
Pets are not allowed.
Parties/events are not allowed
Guests must be quiet between 22:00 and 07:00.
Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to accommodation type.
